ownerStatement: Owner, 14 October 2026: "Let's bring the 95 thingy also live"; then "I allow" when told the release needs a hardware, chip-cycle and memory waiver recorded in this file.
reason: Owner released the Tape Echo MIX dry-law fix for issue #607 after software verification only: the ColdFire kernel matches the native oracle bit for bit and the host voicing gate passes. No hardware, chip-cycle or complete memory measurement exists for this version, and the earlier freeze at seven instances remains open. This binds only this exact version and native source; hardware remains untested.
